pattern: Generated cards inflate objects into toy-like pillows. Bodies swell into balloons, flat planes and rims bulge, corners turn into soft blobs, and parts that should be thin are fattened into sausages or stubby knobs. Examples are whisk wires, pan handles, rolling-pin handles, kettle spouts, and toaster or grate feet. Real cards keep thin parts slim, flat surfaces planar and corners tightly bevelled.
